# Isolde Pembroke

## Appearance

Isolde is an extremely lovely young woman with black hair, dark eyes, dimples, and a rosy complexion. She possesses dark ringlets and a bright, cheerful demeanor inherited from her father. During her youth, she often worried about being plump or looking like a dumpling.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c33 P13](../source/v01-c33.md#nw-v01-c33-p0013), [v2 c27 P39](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0039), [v3 c2 P4](../source/v03-c02.md#nw-v03-c02-p0004)_

## Personality

Isolde is cheerful, kind, sweet, and practical. She is a loyal and devoted friend who selflessly appreciates the talents and virtues of others. She displays a practical nature, though she engaged in imaginative games like the Story Club during her school years.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064), [v1 c12 P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 c21 P17](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0017), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v3 c12 P59](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0059)_

## History

Isolde Pembroke grew up at Pear Hill and formed an early, intense friendship with Nell Harcourt. Together they played in the Whispering Wood, constructed playhouses, and attended Brierley school. During her school days, Isolde participated in the Story Club alongside Nell, Odette Pullen, and Opal Pettigrew. As she grew older, she served as treasurer for the Brierley Village Improvement Society, taking part in various community projects. In her late teens, she became engaged to Gideon Duckett and married him a few years later. Following her marriage, she gave birth to her first child, a son.

_Sources: [v1 c8 P37](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0037), [v1 c12 P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), [v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v2 c6 P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 c29 P15](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0015), [v2 c29 P24](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0024), [v3 c12 P10](../source/v03-c12.md#nw-v03-c12-p0010), [v3 c28 P23](../source/v03-c28.md#nw-v03-c28-p0023), [v3 c39 P41](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0041), [v3 c39 P47](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0047)_
